verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say it automatically creates snapshots on every Omarchy update and offers an `omarchy-snapshot create` command for manual snapshots. That is the product's own foundation for update rollback, but the evidence never documents the actual rollback or restore step. missing for 10: documented restore/rollback procedure (e.g. boot-menu or CLI restore), details on what the snapshot covers, independent or hands-on confirmation that rollback after a broken update works.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can roll back the system to a previous snapshot if an update breaks something

citations.quote: We create snapshots automatically on every Omarchy update, but should you want to create your own, you can use omarchy-snapshot create.
